olivia: Quick ping — PR #4822 updates authz checks and adds an on-prem KMS helper. Need sec quick review, aiming to merge in today's 16:00 UTC slot if no blockers. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4822 :pray:

michael: looking now. does this change SA scopes? can't tell from diff quickly.

olivia: it narrows the SA scopes, but introduces a new component that reads from customer KMS when private_deploy=true. code: `kmsClient.getKey(policyKey)` — we added `kms_helpers/onprem_adapter.py`.

sara: please confirm there are no plaintext creds in the bundle. can you paste the `kms_helpers` init snippet?

olivia: sure —
```
# kms_helpers/onprem_adapter.py
def get_key(name):
    # uses IAM token from node SA; no static creds
    token = metadata_server.get_token()
    return KMSClient(token).fetch(name)
```

sara: ok thanks. sec-scan?

sec-bot: scan: secret-detection: no findings; deps-check: flagged `legacy-crypto-lib` -> low severity, see ticket #990

raj: quick callout — the change touches VPC auth flow in `deploy/vpc.py`; please add a unit test for auth fallback when KMS unreachable. otherwise LGTM.

olivia: added a unit test, pushed as fixup. CI green except for flaky integration job (timing). link to updated PR.

michael: I can approve once unit test is present and integration passes. @sara any privacy concerns with logging key IDs? we log truncated key id only.

sara: truncated ID ok. need a note in PR about redaction — add `logger.info('kms key used=%s', key_id[:8])` -> fine.

olivia: added note and updated changelog. Would like to merge at 16:00 UTC if we get 1 more sec approve.

raj: approved. @michael please add your +1 so we can queue the merge.

michael: +1. merging slot looks clear. deploy-bot: schedule merge at 16:00 UTC, canary 10% for 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled: PR #4822 -> merge at 16:00 UTC, canary policy: 10% for 15m, rollback hook set.

olivia: thanks all — will monitor logs. I'll open follow-up ticket to replace `legacy-crypto-lib` next sprint.

sara: thank you! :thumbsup:

olivia: pinging ops on rotation plan in case customers on private deploy need KMS key ops — @raj can you coordinate?

raj: yep, will sync with ops and send an ops runbook update.
